summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature test run. 58/60 PASSED. The new PUT endpoints for suppliers/bills/sales all work correctly, return updated docs without _id, return 404 for nonexistent ids, and dashboard totals correctly reflect PUT updates (verified $100 bill -> $250 -> totalPurchases jumps by $250, not $100). POST /api/ai/reconcile-statement works as specified: missing key -> 401 'Missing Google Gemini API key. Set it in Settings.', bogus key -> 400 with INVALID_ARGUMENT / API_KEY_INVALID (proves gemini-3.5-flash model resolves at Google), missing imageBase64 -> 422, optional supplierId accepted in schema. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: PUT /api/payments/{id} is MISSING from server.py — the endpoint returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Main agent claimed to add it but server.py lines 362-379 only contain GET/POST/DELETE for /payments — no PUT handler exists. All 48 previously-passing tests still pass (30 vocash + 9 ledgr features + 9 gemini fix).

critical.issue: Endpoint is NOT implemented in server.py — returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Main agent stated this was added but the handler is missing. server.py has @api_router.get/post/delete for /payments but no @api_router.put. Add an update_payment handler modeled after update_bill (line 322-329).

minor.issue: New PUT endpoints do not enforce existence BEFORE update — they call update_one() first (which is a no-op for a missing id) and only then re-fetch to check for 404. Currently the 404 branch works because find_one returns None on a missing id, but a slightly cleaner pattern would be to check existence first or inspect update_result.matched_count. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py 292-299 (PUT suppliers), 322-329 (PUT bills), 352-359 (PUT sales): consistent pattern, good. But NO analogous handler exists for payments — this is the bug.

server.py 680-768 (reconcile-statement): well-structured — schema-driven, uses shared get_api_key/gemini_client helpers, uses GEMINI_MODEL constant, and includes matching logic (±3 days, ±1% amount). Matching pool selection by entry type is correct.

server.py: PUT handlers accept the *Create pydantic models (SupplierCreate/BillCreate/SaleCreate). That means PUT is effectively full-replace of the mutable fields — clients must send all required fields. Acceptable, but a PATCH with Optional[...] fields would be more forgiving. Non-blocking.

rca_of_issue:
MISSING ENDPOINT — PUT /api/payments/{id}. RCA: main agent added @api_router.put decorators for /suppliers/{sid}, /bills/{bid}, /sales/{sid} but forgot the analogous handler for /payments/{pid}. REPRODUCTION: curl -X PUT $BASE/api/payments/anything -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"date":"2026-01-01","amount":1,"currency":"USD","type":"supplier_payment"}' -> HTTP 405 {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}. FIX (single block, ~7 lines): add after line 379 of server.py:

@api_router.put("/payments/{pid}")
async def update_payment(pid: str, body: PaymentCreate):
    doc = body.model_dump()
    await db.payments.update_one({"id": pid}, {"$set": doc})
    p = await db.payments.find_one({"id": pid}, {"_id": 0})
    if not p:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Payment not found")
    return p
